remarks: WELCOME TO THE BEAUTIFULLY RENOVATED AND IDEALLY LOCATED 80 COUNTY STREET, UNIT 7B! This refreshed first-floor condominium offers a wonderful combination of style, comfort, convenience, and value in one of the community's most desirable settings. Recent improvements include fresh paint throughout, refinished floors, new kitchen flooring, and an updated kitchen featuring brand-new appliances, creating a bright and inviting space ready to enjoy. The functional layout is filled with natural light, while the first-floor location provides easy, stair-free access. From the front of the unit, enjoy direct views of the pool and clubhouse, while the rear patio opens to an expansive green lawn, offering a peaceful outdoor setting and a wonderful extension of the living space. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer and one assigned parking space conveniently located directly in front of the building.  Conveniently located near Metro-North, I-95, Route 7, shopping, dining, parks, and Norwalk's waterfront. With its fresh renovation, desirable first-floor location, community amenities, generous outdoor space, and convenient setting, this home presents an exceptional opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.
